fusions.name: Anvil Drop
fusions.desc: A crushing overhead blow that deals 36 damage, ignores armour and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Clang Sweep
fusions.desc: Sweeps your plates around you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles with a 30% chance of [Weakened] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Wall of Plate
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 30 damage and holds for 8 seconds, and raises your armour by 15% while it holds.

fusions.name: Tempered Hide
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 15%, and you have 10% physical resistance.
